## Exploring data + wrangling

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

### Loading the loaded data

```{r}
#| message: FALSE
patients <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_patients.tsv"))
samples <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_samples.tsv"))
mutations <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_mutations.tsv"))
```

### Cleaning data?

```{r}
#patients |> view()
#samples |> view()
#mutations |> view()
```

```{r}
patients <- patients |> 
  mutate(OS_STATUS = case_when(
    OS_STATUS == '1:DECEASED' ~ 'DECEASED',
    OS_STATUS == '0:LIVING' ~ 'LIVING'
  ))

patients
```

#### Renaming the data columns

```{r}
patients_rename <- patients |> 
  rename (
    Patient_ID = PATIENT_ID,
    Sex = SEX,
    Os_Months = OS_MONTHS,
    Os_Status = OS_STATUS,
    Age_Group =  AGE_GROUP,
    Drug_Type = DRUG_TYPE
  )
```

```{r}
patients_rename
```

```{r}
samples_rename <- samples |> 
  rename(
    Patient_ID = PATIENT_ID,
    Sample_ID = SAMPLE_ID,
    Cancer_Type = CANCER_TYPE,
    Sample_Type = SAMPLE_TYPE,
    Sample_Class = SAMPLE_CLASS,
    Metastatic_Site = METASTATIC_SITE,
    Primary_Site = PRIMARY_SITE,
    Cancer_Type_Detailed = CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED,
    Gene_Panel = GENE_PANEL,
    Sample_coverage = SAMPLE_COVERAGE,
    Tumor_Purity = TUMOR_PURITY,
    Oncotree_Code = ONCOTREE_CODE,
    Institute = INSTITUTE,
    Somatic_Status = SOMATIC_STATUS,
    Age_At_Seq_Report = AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT,
    TMB_Nonsynonymous = TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS
  )
```

```{r}
samples_rename
```

### Combining some data

```{r}
survival_table <- full_join(patients,samples, by = 'PATIENT_ID')
survival_table |> select('PATIENT_ID','OS_STATUS','CANCER_TYPE', 'SEX','OS_MONTHS')

survival_table
```

```{r}
g1 <- ggplot(data = survival_table,
            mapping = aes(y = CANCER_TYPE,
                          x = OS_MONTHS,
                          color = SEX)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
g1
```

Calculate the percent of survival for each cancer type

```{r}
survival_table
survival_table |> filter(survival_table$CANCER_TYPE == 'Skin Cancer, Non-Melanoma')
```

```{r}
survival_percentage <- survival_table |> 
  group_by(CANCER_TYPE, SEX) |> 
  summarise(number_of_patients = n(),
  average_survival = mean(OS_MONTHS, na.rm = TRUE),
  alive = sum(OS_STATUS == 'LIVING', na.rm = TRUE),
  survival_percent = alive / number_of_patients * 100)

g2 <- ggplot(data = survival_percentage,
             mapping = aes(x = CANCER_TYPE,
                           y = survival_percent,
                           fill = SEX)) + 
  geom_col(position = 'dodge')+
  labs (title = 'Survival percentage for each cancer type',
        x = 'Cancer type',
        y = 'Survival percent (%)')+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 20,
    hjust = 0.75))
g2

```

```{r}
survival_percentage <- survival_table |> 
  group_by(SEX) |> 
  summarise(
    number_of_patients = n(),
    alive = sum(OS_STATUS == 'LIVING', na.rm = TRUE),
    survival_percent = alive / number_of_patients * 100)
g3 <- ggplot(data = survival_percentage,
             mapping = aes(x = SEX,
                           y = survival_percent,
                           fill = SEX)) + 
  geom_col(position = 'dodge')+
  labs (title = 'Survival percentage for each cancer type',
        x = 'Sex',
        y = 'Survival percent (%)')+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 20,
    hjust = 0.75))
g3
```

## Survival curve

```{r}
survival_curve_test <- survival_table |> 
  group_by(SEX,OS_MONTHS) |> 
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(OS_STATUS == 'DECEASED'),
    living = sum(OS_STATUS == 'LIVING'),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |> 
  
  arrange(SEX,OS_MONTHS) |> 
  
  group_by(SEX) |> 
  mutate(
    at_risk = rev(cumsum(rev(deaths + living))),
    survival = cumprod(1 - deaths/at_risk)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()


#survival_curve_test
g1 <- ggplot(data = survival_curve_test,
             mapping = aes(x = OS_MONTHS,
                           y = survival,
                           color = SEX))+
  geom_step()+
  labs(title = 'Overall survival by sex',
       x = 'Overall survival (months)',
       y = 'Survival probability',
       color = 'Sex')+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = 'bottom')
g1
```
